evals.name: reuse-before-create
evals.query: Create a new PrimaryLinkButton component for the donate page.
expected_behavior: Searches src/shared/ui and finds ButtonLink before creating anything.
Adds a variant to the existing component if needed instead of a near-duplicate.
Keeps it a Server Component and spreads native attributes onto the root.

evals.name: variant-naming-consistency
evals.query: Add a color prop to the category badge so it can be green or maroon.
expected_behavior: Uses the shared variant vocabulary (variant) with a string union, not a free-form color string.
Maps variants to semantic tokens, not hex values.
Pairs category color with its label (color-systems-contrast-intelligence).

evals.name: should-not-trigger-registry-pick
evals.query: Find a nice animated testimonial carousel from Magic UI for the community page.
expected_behavior: Does not load component-api-design as the primary skill; designing-ui-components owns registry discovery and visual options.
